description: High-value, low-noise application security event catalogue for custom software vendors targeting Government and Enterprise SOC teams (aligned to OWASP Logging Vocabulary, OWASP ASVS, and ACSC ISM System Monitoring).

events.description: User or service principal authenticated successfully.
events.noise_control: Emit once per interactive login or token issuance, never on every authenticated HTTP request.

events.description: Authentication attempt failed (invalid credentials, expired account, unknown user).
events.noise_control: Never log the submitted password; normalise reason codes so brute force and password spraying can be aggregated.

events.description: Successful login immediately following consecutive failed authentication attempts.
events.noise_control: Only emit when failed_attempts >= 3 within the configured window.

events.description: Account or client locked out after exceeding failed login threshold.
events.noise_control: Emit on state transition into lockout, not on every subsequent rejected attempt while locked.

events.description: Multi-factor authentication challenge completed successfully.
events.noise_control: Record phishing-resistant factor type (fido2, webauthn, totp, push) for Essential Eight verification.

events.description: Multi-factor authentication challenge failed, timed out, or was denied by user (MFA fatigue indicator).
events.noise_control: Distinguish invalid_code vs user_denied vs expired in the reason field.

events.description: MFA disabled, reset, or downgraded for an account or tenant.
events.noise_control: Always emit; rare and high-value persistence/account-takeover indicator.

events.description: Password changed or reset (self-service or admin-initiated).
events.noise_control: Never log old or new password values or hashes.

events.description: Refresh token, session, or API token explicitly revoked.
events.noise_control: Log token_id/hash prefix only, never the token secret.

events.description: Explicit user logout or administrative session termination.
events.noise_control: Log explicit logouts and forced revocations; skip silent background cache evictions.

events.description: Suspicious session behaviour detected (e.g., replay of revoked refresh token, impossible travel, token binding mismatch).
events.noise_control: Only emit on verified security invariant violations, not routine mobile IP roams.

events.description: Authenticated principal attempted an action or resource access without required permission (potential IDOR/BOLA or privilege probing).
events.noise_control: Do not emit for expected UI feature-flag checks; emit only on enforced server-side access denials (HTTP 403).

events.description: Privileged administrative operation executed (state-changing admin action).
events.noise_control: Log state-changing admin actions and sensitive views; avoid logging every passive admin dashboard poll.

events.description: Administrator or support engineer started impersonating another user.
events.noise_control: Always emit with both actor.id and actor.impersonated_by populated.

events.description: New user account provisioned in the application.
events.noise_control: Always emit; include whether account has privileged roles.

events.description: Security-relevant attributes of a user account were modified (email, status, org unit, auth binding).
events.noise_control: Record field names changed, not raw PII payloads; skip trivial profile preference changes (e.g., UI dark mode).

events.description: User account disabled, suspended, or archived.
events.noise_control: Always emit.

events.description: User account permanently deleted.
events.noise_control: Always emit.

events.description: Role or elevated privilege granted to a user or service principal.
events.noise_control: Always emit; escalate severity to CRITICAL for global/break-glass admin roles.

events.description: Role or elevated privilege removed from a user or service principal.
events.noise_control: Always emit.

events.description: New API key, OAuth client secret, or webhook signing key created.
events.noise_control: Log key_id and granted scopes; NEVER log the key secret.

events.description: API key or client credential revoked or rotated.
events.noise_control: Always emit.

events.description: Client exceeded security rate limit on sensitive endpoint (login, search, export, OTP).
events.noise_control: Emit once per rate-limit window per actor/IP (summary/suppression), not once for every blocked packet during a flood.

events.description: Access to a high-sensitivity record (e.g., OFFICIAL:Sensitive / PROTECTED / regulated citizen record).
events.noise_control: Only log access to explicitly classified/sensitive holdings, never routine public or catalogue reads.

events.description: Bulk export, report download, or large query against sensitive application data.
events.noise_control: Always emit for exports above threshold (e.g., >= 50 sensitive records or any full-table dump).

events.description: Deletion or purge of sensitive business records or audit artefacts.
events.noise_control: Always emit.

events.description: Security configuration changed (SSO/IdP settings, CORS, IP allowlists, webhook URLs, password/MFA policy, encryption settings).
events.noise_control: Log key name and safe before/after summary (redact secrets).

events.description: High-confidence injection, path traversal, SSRF, or deserialisation payload blocked by application controls.
events.noise_control: Do NOT emit for routine form typos (e.g., missing email @); emit only on explicit security control blocks (traversal, SSRF allowlist block, signature/deserialisation rejection).

events.description: Cryptographic signature, JWT, SAML assertion, webhook HMAC, or mTLS certificate verification failed.
events.noise_control: Distinguish expired_token from invalid_signature; invalid_signature is high-signal tampering.

events.description: Application service started or restarted with deployed version and security posture summary.
events.noise_control: Emit once per process start.

events.description: Periodic low-frequency telemetry heartbeat proving the security log pipeline is alive (detects silent log dropouts).
events.noise_control: Emit at most once every 15-60 minutes per service (not per pod per second).

events.description: Attempt to disable security logging, reduce audit verbosity below baseline, alter sink targets, or clear audit trails.
events.noise_control: Always emit as CRITICAL; pair with SIEM heartbeat absence alert.
